summary:
1. The Problem
Since space exploration began, NASA has sent numerous machines to the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space. Some have completed their missions, others remain active, while some are inactive or lost. Although information about these machines exists, their stories and achievements are not always presented in an engaging, accessible way for younger generations.

2. Our Solution
SPACE ECHOES is an interactive educational mobile application that brings NASA's hardware stories to life. Users can explore the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space, discover associated machines, and follow their journeys, achievements, and statuses. It features visual storytelling, mission status tracking, 3-question quizzes, and FLASH AI, a chatbot for space-related questions.

3. Impact
SPACE ECHOES aims to inspire scientific curiosity and make space science accessible to the next generation. By combining trusted NASA information with interactive learning and AI assistance, it encourages young learners to explore space technology and appreciate its scientific and historical contributions.
4. Challenge Alignment
SPACE ECHOES addresses the challenge by telling the stories of NASA hardware left across the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space since the 1960s. It transforms mission information into engaging educational experiences, helping users understand why these machines were sent, what they achieved, and what happened to them.
The end of a mission doesn't mean the end of its impact.
details:
1. How It Works

SPACE ECHOES is an interactive educational application that allows users to explore NASA's space exploration hardware across three destinations: the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space.

Users select a destination, discover the machines associated with it, and learn about each machine's story, mission, achievements, and current status. Each machine includes visual content explaining its journey, followed by a 3-question quiz to test users' understanding. The application also features FLASH AI, an AI-powered chatbot that helps users ask questions and discover more about space missions.

Explore three destinations: Moon, Mars, and Deep Space.

2. Benefits

The application makes complex scientific information easier to understand through visual storytelling videos accompanying each machine. These videos narrate its story from launch until it reaches its final location in space. Combined with interactive learning, this approach makes discovering space technology more engaging and enjoyable for young learners.

3. Intended Impact

SPACE ECHOES

It aims to inspire the next generation and increase their interest in space science and exploration. It also helps preserve the scientific legacy of NASA's hardware by making its stories and achievements accessible to young learners.

Because understanding the past helps us discover the future.

4. Tools and Technologies

The project was developed using the following technologies:

  • Mobile Application: Flutter and Dart.
  • Backend: Node.js and Express.js.
  • Database: MongoDB and Mongoose.
  • AI Chatbot: Python and FastAPI.
  • Information Retrieval: BM25.
  • AI Support Libraries: Pydantic and Uvicorn.
  • Mobile Libraries: Dio, Flutter SVG, ScreenUtil, and Google Fonts.
  • Authentication: JWT and bcryptjs.
  • API Testing: Postman.

Mission-related information and educational content were researched using official NASA sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.

5. Creativity and Innovation

Our creative approach transforms NASA's historical space mission data into an interactive space exploration experience. Instead of simply reading about machines, users discover their stories through space destinations, visual storytelling, mission status indicators, and quizzes that reinforce learning. FLASH AI further enhances the experience by helping users access additional information and explore their questions.

6. Factors Considered

Our team considered the target audience (ages 15–18), ease of use, accessibility, scientific accuracy, engaging visual design, and educational value. Our goal was to create an experience that makes space exploration easy to understand, enjoyable, and memorable.
